title: 2021 Topps Jose Urena #134 Miami Marlins MLB Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The MLB 2021 Topps Jose Urena #134 trading card is a standard-sized single card featuring the player from the 2021 Topps set. Manufactured by Topps in the United States, this original card is made of 20 Pt. card stock and belongs to the base set for Major League Baseball. The card showcases Jose Urena of the Miami Marlins and is a must-have for baseball fans and collectors looking to add a piece of the 2021 season to their collection.
